name: Blood of Innocents
summary: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon prepares a remedy for the Venture Company in Stonetalon Mountains. The Royal Apothecary Society turns to blood taken by local bandits to pacify the company.

sections.title: A Chemical Solution
sections.body: Horde leaders in Kalimdor have turned to the Royal Apothecary Society for help against the Venture Company. The company ravages the wilderness and harms its people, so Apothecary Lydon proposes alchemy instead of sending armies to blunt their axes. He means to brew an agent that will paralyze and pacify the mercenaries, leaving them weak and docile.

sections.title: Stolen from the Wicked
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon needs a rare and troubling ingredient: innocent blood. He will not send Horde agents to kill innocents, so he turns to the Syndicate's crimes. Fallen nobles and cutthroats occupy Durnholde Keep, where rogue shadow mages harvest innocent blood for profane rituals. Lydon targets those mages for alchemical supplies.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon need innocent blood?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon needs innocent blood for an experimental brew. He hopes its toxin will drain the Venture Company's violent drive in Stonetalon Mountains, leaving its members subdued and easier to handle.

faq.q: Who has the vials of innocent blood?
aliases: where to get blood of innocents
faq.answer: Syndicate shadow mages carry the vials of innocent blood. They lurk among the ruins of Durnholde Keep, southeast of Tarren Mill, and keep the blood for their spellwork.

faq.q: Why does a Hillsbrad quest involve the Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Horde leaders in Kalimdor sought scientific aid from the Royal Apothecary Society in the Eastern Kingdoms. The Venture Company conflict lies in Stonetalon, while Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill knows the dark craft needed to brew a specialized remedy.

The Syndicate is made up of former human nobles from the ruined kingdom of Alterac, now brigands, assassins, and cutthroats. They hope to reclaim their lost lands, using extortion and dark magic while preying on travelers in Hillsbrad and Alterac.
Durnholde Keep lies southeast of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Once a human fortress and orc internment camp, it is now half in ruins and a major Syndicate stronghold.

faq.q: Is the Horde committing murder to get this blood?
faq.answer: No. The Royal Apothecary Society accepts gruesome methods, but Lydon directs agents to gather blood the Syndicate shadow mages have already taken from their victims.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, efficiency comes before moral qualms. Lydon's calculated approach shows how the Royal Apothecary Society uses cold logic to solve problems for its living allies.
As a tauren, you may find the taking of innocent blood unsettling. The aim is to end the Venture Company's destruction of the wilderness in Kalimdor.
As a member of the Horde, you see its far-reaching ties at work. Forsaken alchemy in Lordaeron helps protect Horde lands in Kalimdor.
